title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei clarified his position on open-weight AI models, stating opposition isn't to their existence but to concerns about China's advancing AI capabilities. This reflects broader industry concerns about geopolitical competition in AI development.
content: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.

zh.title: Anthropic的Dario Amodei回应：不反对开放权重模型，但担心中国AI
zh.summary: Anthropic首席执行官Dario Amodei澄清了他对开源权重AI模型的立场，声称他的反对不是针对这些模型的存在，而是对中国AI能力提升的担忧。这反映了整个行业对AI发展中地缘政治竞争的担忧。
